name: carrier_watch_blast
_comment: Wave 5, B NPC carrier take 2: carrier_watch.json with kits/viper_blast.mjs installed too, so the hostile STOCK Fed Carrier (pilot w5_fedcarrier, sÿst 2011) launches stock Fed Vipers that also carry the 400 px Kit Blast Shell.
